articles.summary: Mark Widmar, chief executive officer of First Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLR) (“First Solar” or “the Company”), today urged bipartisan support for an industrial strategy and the enforcement of American trade and tax laws to sustain domestic manufacturing growth. At the invitation of Chairman John Moolenaar (R-Mich.), Widmar testified before the United States House Select Committee on the Strategic Competition Between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party (the House Select Committee on China). Addressing the committee at the hearing on “ Outproducing the CCP: Restoring American Manufacturing , ” Widmar said, “American technology, American factories, American workers, and consistent enforcement of our trade and tax laws are not Democratic priorities or Republican ones. They are American ones.” First Solar is the country’s leading PV solar technology and manufacturing company and the only one of the world’s largest solar manufacturers to be headquartered in the US. The Company
articles.title: First Solar CEO Urges Bipartisan Support for Industrial Strategy, Enforcement of US Trade and Tax Policy at House Select Committee on China Hearing
